cohort: Live newborn infants with birth weight between 500-1500 grams admitted to the NICU at Adichunchanagiri Institute Of Medical Sciences between October 2021 and September 2022.
finding: Proper antenatal care reduces the risk of VLBW and improves survival, reducing morbidity and mortality among VLBW infants.
mod_finding: 46% of the VLBW infants were delivered vaginally and 54% by cesarean delivery.
